title: Polygon Future?
description:
In this episode from IBW 2025, we sat with Aishwary from Polygon to discuss ARK and a few key topics around crypto market and crypto in india.

00:00 – Introduction
02:20 – What is ARC?
06:55 – ARC’s biggest real-world use case
10:15 – ARC’s role in Web3
11:25 – What’s happening with altcoins right now?
17:05 – L1 vs L2 blockchains: the ongoing fight
17:48 – Polygon’s plans
19:05 – Current status of crypto and blockchain regulation in India

Aishwary LinkedIn: https://in.linkedin.com/in/aishwary1992
Aiswary X: https://x.com/0xAishwary
